e.summary: 42 条记录覆盖 9 个州：受理确认/回复/决定/支付等各环节的天数、日类型与法规出处，逐条可回溯

e.summary_hk: 42 條記錄覆蓋 9 個州：受理確認/回覆/決定/支付等各環節的天數、日類型與法規出處，逐條可回溯
e.body:
这份数据集回答一个很具体、很实务的问题：**美国各州给了保险公司多少天来处理一笔理赔**。数据由 **referencesource** 发布，**HF 镜像**为 `referencesource/insurance-claim-handling-deadlines`，**权威站点**为 `referencesource.org/insurance-claim-handling-deadlines/`（HTTP 200，30.8KB），并提供**机器可读**的 `…/data.json`（HTTP 200，47KB）。

**实测结构**：**42 条记录、覆盖 9 个州**；**10 类义务**——受理确认（8）、接受或拒赔（7）、回复往来函件（6）、提供理赔表格（5）、完成调查（4）、告知需要更多时间（4）、支付已接受赔案（4）、启动调查（2）、现场查勘（1）、寄送损失估算（1）；**日类型**——`days` 25、`working days` 9、`business days` 5、`calendar days` 3；**载体**——**行政法规 27 条、成文法 15 条**。每条记录带 `citation`（法条编号）、`clock_starts`（**时钟从哪个事件起算**）、`deadline_days`、`day_type`、`obligation`、`instrument_type`、`line_of_business`、`penalty_or_interest`、`source`（读取该值的页面 URL）与 **`source_quote`（该页面的逐字引文）**；实测 **42 条全部含 source 与 source_quote，无一条缺失**。

**本次亲自复核（本 wiki 的核实标准）**：抽取两条记录回到**官方原始出处**逐字比对，**两条均完全吻合**——**明尼苏达州 Stat. 72A.201**（`revisor.mn.gov`，HTTP 200，107KB：「failing to complete its investigation and inform the insured or claimant of acceptance or denial of a claim **within 30 business days after receipt of notification of claim**」）与**内华达州 NAC 686A.675**（`leg.state.nv.us`，HTTP 200，314KB：「**Within 30 working days** after receipt by the insurer of properly executed proofs of loss…」）。

对 RIAA：理赔时限是**运营与合规的第一线知识**，也是「理赔到底谁说了算」的法律起点。这份数据的价值有三层：**①** 它把笼统的「及时处理」拆成**十个可计时的义务**——学生做理赔流程、SLA 或自动理赔设计时，这十个环节就是天然的检查表；**②** 它显式区分**日历日 / 工作日 / 营业日**（42 条中分别有 3 / 9 / 5 条不是普通日）——**这正是理赔时效计算里最经典的坑**，把 30 天当自然日算会直接算错合规期限；**③** 它替使用者做了法规溯源：**每条都给出法条编号与原文句子**，可以直接引到作业或合规文档里。相关条目：监管数据见 [[naic-financial-data-repository]]，州级费率申报数据见 [[texas-rate-filings]]，理赔自动化与代理见 [[claims-intake-agent]]、[[claims-triage-mcp]]、[[digital-claims-management]]、[[claims-api]]、[[evidence-review-claims]]，规则即代码的同类做法见 [[openfisca]]、[[psl-tax-calculator]]、[[bind-standard]]、[[acord]]。

⚠️ **必须如实标注的四点**：**① 只有 9 个州、42 条记录**，并非「全美五十州」——标题里的「by state」容易让人高估覆盖面；**② 发布方 `referencesource` 同时批量发布数百份彼此无关的参考数据**（鹿猎季日期、自行车传动兼容、刀具牌号对照等），**属于流水线式出版**，本次核实的是**这一份**的质量，不代表其全部数据集同等可靠，同类数据应逐份核查；**③ HF 镜像只是某一时点的快照**——该数据集自述 **last verified 2026-08-11、stale after 2026-12-09**，并明确要求过期后改用权威站点（该站点按节奏重新核验）；**④** 许可证为 `other`（自述为「引用来源条款」：法条文本依美国法不受版权保护，每条仅引用一句并回链到州政府页面）。**核实说明**：HF 数据集元数据、records.jsonl 全量解析、权威站点与 data.json 均实测（HTTP 200）；**并亲自回到明尼苏达与内华达两处官方原文比对引文，两处吻合**；**其余 40 条未逐条回源核对**。
e.body_en:
This dataset answers a very concrete, practical question: **how many days each US state gives an insurer to handle a claim**. It is published by **referencesource**; the **Hugging Face mirror** is `referencesource/insurance-claim-handling-deadlines` and the **canonical site** is `referencesource.org/insurance-claim-handling-deadlines/` (HTTP 200, 30.8KB), with a **machine-readable** `…/data.json` (HTTP 200, 47KB).

**Measured structure**: **42 records across 9 states**; **10 obligation types** — acknowledge receipt of claim (8), accept or deny claim (7), reply to communication (6), provide claim forms (5), complete investigation (4), notify of need for more time (4), pay accepted claim (4), begin investigation (2), conduct physical inspection (1), send loss estimate (1); **day types** — `days` 25, `working days` 9, `business days` 5, `calendar days` 3; **instrument** — **27 administrative regulations, 15 statutes**. Every record carries `citation`, `clock_starts` (**which event starts the clock**), `deadline_days`, `day_type`, `obligation`, `instrument_type`, `line_of_business`, `penalty_or_interest`, `source` (the URL the value was read from) and **`source_quote` (a verbatim quote from that page)**; measured: **all 42 records carry both source and source_quote, none missing**.

**Checked personally here (this wiki’s verification standard)**: two records were taken back to their **official primary sources** and compared word for word, and **both matched exactly** — **Minnesota Stat. 72A.201** (`revisor.mn.gov`, HTTP 200, 107KB: "failing to complete its investigation and inform the insured or claimant of acceptance or denial of a claim **within 30 business days after receipt of notification of claim**") and **Nevada NAC 686A.675** (`leg.state.nv.us`, HTTP 200, 314KB: "**Within 30 working days** after receipt by the insurer of properly executed proofs of loss…").

For RIAA: claim-handling deadlines are **front-line operational and compliance knowledge**, and the legal starting point for "who decides a claim, and by when". The value is threefold: **①** it breaks the vague instruction to "handle claims promptly" into **ten clock-able obligations** — a ready-made checklist when students design claims processes, SLAs or automated claims; **②** it distinguishes explicitly between **calendar, working and business days** (of the 42 records, 3, 9 and 5 respectively are not plain days) — **the classic trap in claims-timeliness calculation**, where treating 30 days as calendar days simply computes the wrong deadline; **③** it does the legal sourcing for the user: **every record gives the citation and the original sentence**, quotable directly into coursework or compliance documents. Related entries: regulatory data in [[naic-financial-data-repository]], state rate filings in [[texas-rate-filings]], claims automation and agents in [[claims-intake-agent]], [[claims-triage-mcp]], [[digital-claims-management]], [[claims-api]] and [[evidence-review-claims]], and the "rules as code" analogue in [[openfisca]], [[psl-tax-calculator]], [[bind-standard]] and [[acord]].

⚠️ **Four things that must be stated plainly**: **① only 9 states and 42 records** — this is not "all fifty states", and the "by state" phrasing invites overestimating coverage; **② the publisher `referencesource` also bulk-publishes hundreds of unrelated reference datasets** (deer season dates, bike drivetrain compatibility, cutting-tool grade cross-references), i.e. **pipeline publishing** — what was verified here is **this one dataset**, and its siblings should be checked individually rather than assumed equally reliable; **③ the Hugging Face mirror is a point-in-time snapshot** — the dataset states **last verified 2026-08-11, stale after 2026-12-09**, and explicitly asks users to switch to the canonical site (which re-verifies on a cadence) past that date; **④** the licence is `other` (self-described as "source terms cited": statutory text is not copyrightable in the US, and each record quotes a single sentence and links back to the state’s own page). **Verification note**: HF dataset metadata, a full parse of records.jsonl, the canonical site and data.json were all measured (HTTP 200); **two citations were personally traced back to Minnesota and Nevada official texts and matched**; **the remaining 40 records were not traced back individually**.
e.body_hk:
這份數據集回答一個很實務的問題：**美國各州給了保險公司多少天來處理一筆理賠**。由 **referencesource** 發布，**HF 鏡像**為 `referencesource/insurance-claim-handling-deadlines`，**權威站點**為 `referencesource.org/insurance-claim-handling-deadlines/`（HTTP 200，30.8KB），並提供**機器可讀**的 `…/data.json`（HTTP 200，47KB）。

**實測結構**：**42 條記錄、覆蓋 9 個州**；**10 類義務**——受理確認（8）、接受或拒賠（7）、回覆往來函件（6）、提供理賠表格（5）、完成調查（4）、告知需要更多時間（4）、支付已接受賠案（4）、啟動調查（2）、現場查勘（1）、寄送損失估算（1）；**日類型**——`days` 25、`working days` 9、`business days` 5、`calendar days` 3；**載體**——**行政法規 27 條、成文法 15 條**。每條記錄帶 `citation`、`clock_starts`（**時鐘從哪個事件起算**）、`deadline_days`、`day_type`、`obligation`、`penalty_or_interest`、`source` 與 **`source_quote`（該頁面的逐字引文）**；實測 **42 條全部含 source 與 source_quote**。

**本次親自覆核**：抽兩條回到**官方原始出處**逐字比對，**兩條完全吻合**——**明尼蘇達州 Stat. 72A.201**（`revisor.mn.gov`，HTTP 200）與**內華達州 NAC 686A.675**（`leg.state.nv.us`，HTTP 200）。

對 RIAA：理賠時限是**運營與合規的第一線知識**。價值三層：**①** 把籠統的「及時處理」拆成**十個可計時的義務**，是設計理賠流程/SLA/自動理賠時的天然檢查表；**②** 顯式區分**日曆日 / 工作日 / 營業日**——**這正是理賠時效計算裡最經典的坑**；**③** 每條給出法條編號與原文句子，可直接引用。相關條目：[[naic-financial-data-repository]]、[[texas-rate-filings]]、[[claims-intake-agent]]、[[claims-triage-mcp]]、[[digital-claims-management]]、[[claims-api]]、[[evidence-review-claims]]、[[openfisca]]、[[psl-tax-calculator]]、[[bind-standard]]、[[acord]]。

⚠️ **必須如實標注四點**：**① 只有 9 個州、42 條記錄**，並非「全美五十州」；**② 發布方同時批量發布數百份彼此無關的參考數據**，屬流水線式出版，本次核實的是**這一份**；**③ HF 鏡像只是某一時點的快照**——自述 **last verified 2026-08-11、stale after 2026-12-09**，過期後應改用權威站點；**④** 許可證為 `other`（自述「引用來源條款」）。**核實說明**：HF 元數據、records.jsonl 全量解析、權威站點與 data.json 均實測；**並親自回到明尼蘇達與內華達兩處官方原文比對引文，兩處吻合**；**其餘 40 條未逐條回源**。
e.verified_note: HTTP 200 实测（HF 数据集页、records.jsonl 全量 42 条解析、权威站点 referencesource.org/… 30.8KB、data.json 47KB）+ 亲自回源核对 2 条：Minnesota Stat. 72A.201（revisor.mn.gov HTTP 200，逐字吻合）、Nevada NAC 686A.675（leg.state.nv.us HTTP 200，逐字吻合）+ 实测字段完整性（42/42 含 source 与 source_quote）；发布日期为 HF 快照 2026-08-26、自述 last verified 2026-08-11 / stale after 2026-12-09；其余 40 条未逐条回源
